CONSTITUTION OF INDIA.
NO: GPt24lof/2013iPruVrc20if,1114g/Z:- In exercise of the powers confened by the proviso to
article 309 of the Constitution of Indi4 the Governor of Gujarat hereby makes the followini rutes furrher to
amend the Gujarat Development Service Department Examination Rules, 1990, namely:-
(U 
These rules may.be called the Gujarat Development Service Departnent Examination (Amendment)
Rules, 2013.
(21 ln the Gujarat Development Service DeparEnental Examination Rules, 1990 (hereinafter
referred to as "the said rules"), in rule 4, in the second proviso, for the words ncompleted
four yearsi continuous service", the words "been appointed on regular basis in" shall be
substituted.
(3) 
In the said rules, for rule 10, the following nrle shall be substituted, namely:-
"10. Syllabus and tlpe of the Examination.
The syllabus for the examination shall be as specified in Appendix-A. The
xaminatiol shall be of objective type having multiple choice questions.".
By order and in the name of the Governor of Gujaha!
u. u. PATHAN,
